warning.daily_metrics_review: Some daily metric values need review, such as a value without a date ({code}).
warning.data_file_left_out: Some files could not be read and were left out. run_manifest.json lists them with the reason ({code}).
warning.data_row_left_out: Some rows lacked a required value, such as a date or a usable identifier, or were not records, such as a number in a list of records, and were left out. START_HERE.md gives their number for each table, and the audit files count them by reason ({code}).
warning.data_text_repaired: Some text held a broken character, such as an emoji cut in half. It is written with the replacement character � in its place, and run_manifest.json lists the files ({code}).
warning.data_value_invalid: Some values had a form that their field does not take, such as text where a number belongs. Those fields are left empty, and every such value is kept in the audit files ({code}).
warning.fit_parse_incomplete: Some FIT files could not be read completely. They were left out, and nothing was guessed ({code}).
warning.input_duplicate_sources: The input held the same export more than once, such as the ZIP and the folder extracted from it. It was read once ({code}).
warning.lactate_candidates: There is more than one candidate for the lactate threshold. All are kept, and none was chosen ({code}).
warning.optional_family_empty: Some optional data was in the export but produced no records ({code}).
warning.optional_family_not_present: Some optional data was not in the export, so its tables are empty ({code}).
warning.records_not_in_latest_snapshot: Some records are not in the latest export. They are kept, and the audit files show the last export that had each of them ({code}).
warning.relationship_invalid_link: Some personal records have a link to an activity that is missing, malformed, or disagrees. They are kept with the link unresolved, and nothing was guessed ({code}).
warning.relationship_unresolved: Some links between datasets point to records that are not in the output. Nothing was guessed ({code}).
warning.values_disagree: Some records have values that disagree. Those fields are left empty, and every value is kept in the audit files. None was chosen ({code}).
warning.values_updated: A later export changed some records, such as the name of an activity. The tables have the latest values, and the earlier values are kept in the audit files ({code}).
